scope: Source-boundary check of the al-Farra citation and poem reading noted in Tabari 108:3 note 8; no claim that the KSU-cited print edition is identified.

finding.verified: KSU Tabari 108:3 note 8 gives al-Farra, Ma'ani al-Qur'an, p. 377 and quotes the poem with هل أنت. An accessible IslamWeb presentation labels its al-Kawthar section part 3, page 296 and displays ها أنت. Two secondary presentations (the al-Basit page and a Quranpedia-hosted academic PDF) cite Ma'ani al-Qur'an 3/296 and explicitly report ها أنت as a variant in other witnesses instead of هل أنت.
finding.implication: The page-296 and variant references explain a witness-specific difference; they do not establish that KSU's p. 377 is the same edition, nor which reading is authorial. Keep each reading attached to its witness and the KSU source locator unresolved.
finding.non_finding: No scan page, title page, or colophon for the exact KSU-cited p. 377 edition was visually verified in this check.
